principle: Existing visually coherent 3D assets are canonical forms. A common semantic palette skin is recompiled onto each form's own UV instead of sharing incompatible texture files.

common_skins.custom_image: extract four dominant colors and apply the same recipe to every form

compatibility: Every recipe is compiled from each form's original embedded texture, so UV topology remains native to that form.
rejected_baseline: The previous 72-triangle Blocky common-form page is not the visual baseline.
